title: enterprise secret set|remove|status --json
description: `enterprise secret set|remove|status --json`. Linux and macOS set and remove write (or remove) the credential and run ensure under one lifecycle lock, and print lifecycle result v2 with action ensure (runEnterpriseSecret, internal/cli/enterprise_unix_run_unix.go); an identical value is not rewritten, a failed write is errors[0].code change_failed, and a value the confirmed signed policy bundle does not sign (without a newer --bundle that signs it) is secret_ref_mismatch or, for a bundle signed before 1.0.4, secret_ref_unbound. A failure before the lifecycle runs (an argument, flag, privilege, value or stdin read error, or a caller that exited or stopped before it sent the whole value) prints one schema-1 failure document with exit 1 or 2 (mgmt-agent-api GAP-0031); with --json stdout is never empty. Windows set and remove (internal/cli/enterprise_secret_windows.go) take bundle.lock (waiting up to --lock-wait), then the installer's lifecycle.lock (waiting up to 30 s), write a changed credential, restart the gateway, and with --json print one schema-1 document on every outcome, success or failure; argument and flag errors exit 1639. An identical Windows set is not rewritten but still restarts a running gateway (nothing proves the value it loaded), so the agent sends a credential only when its sha256_prefix differs. Windows builds without management_contract take no lock and print the success document only. status (every OS, no lock, read-only; Windows needs an elevated administrator or SYSTEM and prints the failure document with action status on every failure: elevation_required, invalid_arguments for a flag error, state_invalid when the store cannot be read) lists name, present, sha256_prefix (the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 of the stored value; Windows hashes the value with surrounding whitespace trimmed, Linux and macOS the stored bytes), modified_at and, on Linux and macOS, mode.

gateway_restarted.description: false only when the gateway was not running (restartWindowsStandaloneGateway).

oneOf.title: Windows set, remove or status, failure (management_contract 1)

name.description: As given; absent for status and when --name was missing.

errors.description: elevation_required (exit 5 on a managed computer, 1603 on a computer without the standalone deployment marker); invalid_arguments (1639: bad --name, not exactly one of --from-stdin/--from-file, empty or oversized value, unknown flag); lifecycle_busy (1618: bundle.lock not free within --lock-wait, or lifecycle.lock not free within 30 s; nothing was written, retry); not_installed (1603: no standalone deployment); credential_in_use (1603: remove while the installed config references it, unless --undo-rotation --undo-config names that installed config's SHA-256 on Windows); credential_changed (1603: --if-stored did not match the exact current value or proven absence, so nothing was changed); confirmed_bundle_changed (1603: set --bundle --if-confirmed <manifest SHA-256|none> while another bundle is confirmed; nothing was written); rotation_confirmed (1603: set|remove --undo-rotation <manifest SHA-256|none> once another bundle is confirmed, or while the confirmed bundle signs the value stored now; nothing changed, the stored value is the one to keep); secret_ref_mismatch (1603: set of a value the confirmed signed policy bundle does not sign, or that the --bundle bundle does not sign or that does not verify on this computer; nothing was written: pass the newer bundle that signs the value with --bundle); secret_ref_unbound (1603: the confirmed bundle, signed before 1.0.4, names the credential without its value; nothing was written: pass a bundle that signs the value with --bundle); change_failed (1603: write or remove failed, nothing changed); restart_failed (1603: the gateway did not reload a stored, removed or already-restored credential; retry the call or let the next ensure settle the journal); state_invalid (1603, also when the installer's lifecycle.lock file does not exist, for set, remove and status when a junction, mount point, symlink or file stands where the secrets folder belongs (nothing is read, written or deleted), and for status when the store cannot be read). status fails only with elevation_required, invalid_arguments (exit 1639) or state_invalid (exit 1603).

oneOf.title: Linux / macOS set, remove or status, failure before the lifecycle ran

name.description: As given; absent for status and when --name was missing.

errors.description: invalid_arguments (2: bad --name, not exactly one of --from-stdin/--from-file, a --from-file another account can change, --lock-wait outside 0 to 15m, an unknown flag, an empty, multi-line or oversized value sent in full, or stdin that cannot be read while the caller runs; fix the call); not_root (1: set or remove not run as root, or status that cannot list the root-only store); change_failed (1: the value never arrived whole: the process that started secret set exited before it sent the complete value (its end of the pipe closed with nothing or part of the value written, or a process it started holds the pipe), no value ended within 60 s (the caller stopped without closing stdin), or --from-file cannot be opened; nothing was stored, resubmit the same call once the agent runs again (mgmt-agent-api GAP-0040)); state_invalid (1: the device layout cannot be resolved, or status cannot read the store). Nothing was written. Failures once the lifecycle ran (lifecycle_busy 75, change_failed 1 for a caller that exited while secret set waited for the lock) are lifecycle result v2.

errors.message: another DefenseClaw lifecycle run holds lifecycle.lock; the credential was not stored and the run can be retried

The protected credentials of a managed computer can be read only from an elevated Administrator prompt or by the MDM agent. Ask your administrator, who runs it from an elevated PowerShell prompt with `& 'C:\Program Files\Cisco\DefenseClaw\bin\defenseclaw.exe' enterprise secret status`. Nothing was changed.
the process that started this command exited before it sent the credential, so the credential was not stored; run the command again
